   465→
   466→# --- Cloud SQL Proxy - Standalone Deployment ---
   467→# Only created when proxy_mode is "standalone" (dev).
   468→# QA/prod use sidecar mode (injected via Helm values).
   469→
   470→resource "kubernetes_deployment_v1" "cloud_sql_proxy" {
   471→  count = local.service.database.proxy_mode == "standalone" ? 1 : 0
   472→
   473→  metadata {
   474→    name      = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   475→    namespace = local.service.namespaces.platform
   476→    labels = {
   477→      app        = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   478→      component  = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   479→      managed-by = "terraform"
   480→    }
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  spec {
   484→    replicas = 1
   485→
   486→    selector {
   487→      match_labels = {
   488→        app       = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   489→        component = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   490→      }
   491→    }
   492→
   493→    template {
   494→      metadata {
   495→        labels = {
   496→          app       = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   497→          component = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   498→        }
   499→      }
   500→
   501→      spec {
   502→        service_account_name = local.service.k8s_service_account
   503→
   504→        container {
   505→          name  = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   506→          image = local.global.cloud_sql.proxy_image
   507→
   508→          args = [
   509→            "--structured-logs",
   510→            "--private-ip",
   511→            "--auto-iam-authn",
   512→            "--address=0.0.0.0",
   513→            "--port=5432",
   514→            "--health-check",
   515→            "--http-port=9090",
   516→            "--http-address=0.0.0.0",
   517→            local.global.cloud_sql.connection_string,
   518→          ]
   519→
   520→          port {
   521→            container_port = 5432
   522→            name           = "postgres"
   523→          }
   524→
   525→          port {
   526→            container_port = 9090
   527→            name           = "http"
   528→          }
   529→
   530→          resources {
   531→            requests = {
   532→              cpu    = "100m"
   533→              memory = "128Mi"
   534→            }
   535→            limits = {
   536→              cpu    = "500m"
   537→              memory = "512Mi"
   538→            }
   539→          }
   540→
   541→          security_context {
   542→            run_as_non_root            = true
   543→            run_as_user                = 65532
   544→            allow_privilege_escalation = false
   545→          }
   546→
   547→          liveness_probe {
   548→            http_get {
   549→              path = "/liveness"
   550→              port = 9090
   551→            }
   552→            initial_delay_seconds = 30
   553→            period_seconds        = 10
   554→          }
   555→
   556→          readiness_probe {
   557→            http_get {
   558→              path = "/readiness"
   559→              port = 9090
   560→            }
   561→            initial_delay_seconds = 10
   562→            period_seconds        = 5
   563→          }
   564→        }
   565→      }
   566→    }
   567→  }
   568→
   569→  lifecycle {
   570→    ignore_changes = [
   571→      metadata[0].annotations,
   572→      spec[0].template[0].spec[0].container[0].resources,
   573→      spec[0].template[0].spec[0].container[0].security_context,
   574→      spec[0].template[0].spec[0].security_context,
   575→      spec[0].template[0].spec[0].toleration,
   576→    ]
   577→  }
   578→
   579→  depends_on = [
   580→    kubernetes_namespace_v1.crewai_platform,
   581→    kubernetes_service_account_v1.crewai_platform,
   582→  ]
   583→}
   584→
   585→resource "kubernetes_service_v1" "cloud_sql_proxy" {
   586→  count = local.service.database.proxy_mode == "standalone" ? 1 : 0
   587→
   588→  metadata {
   589→    name      = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   590→    namespace = local.service.namespaces.platform
   591→    labels = {
   592→      app        = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   593→      component  = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   594→      managed-by = "terraform"
   595→    }
   596→  }
   597→
   598→  spec {
   599→    selector = {
   600→      app       = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   601→      component = "cloud-sql-proxy"
   602→    }
   603→
   604→    port {
   605→      port        = 5432
   606→      target_port = 5432
   607→      name        = "postgres"
   608→    }
   609→
   610→    type = "ClusterIP"
   611→  }
   612→
   613→  depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace_v1.crewai_platform]
   614→}
   615→
   616→# --- Database Initialization Job ---
   617→# Grants IAM database user the privileges needed for CrewAI.
   618→# Re-trigger by changing var.database_init_trigger (e.g. v1 -> v2).
   619→
   620→resource "kubernetes_job_v1" "database_init" {
   621→  count = var.run_database_init_job ? 1 : 0
   622→
   623→  metadata {
   624→    name      = "crewai-db-init-${var.database_init_trigger}"
   625→    namespace = local.service.namespaces.platform
   626→    labels = {
   627→      app         = "crewai"
   628→      component   = "database-init"
   629→      environment = local.global.environment
   630→      managed-by  = "terraform"
   631→    }
   632→  }
   633→
   634→  spec {
   635→    ttl_seconds_after_finished = 300
   636→    backoff_limit              = 3
   637→
   638→    template {
   639→      metadata {
   640→        labels = {
   641→          app       = "crewai"
   642→          component = "database-init"
   643→        }
   644→      }
   645→
   646→      spec {
   647→        restart_policy       = "Never"
   648→        service_account_name = local.service.k8s_service_account
   649→
   650→        security_context {
   651→          run_as_non_root = true
   652→          run_as_user     = 1000
   653→          seccomp_profile {
   654→            type = "RuntimeDefault"
   655→          }
   656→        }
   657→
   658→        container {
   659→          name  = "psql"
   660→          image = "postgres:15-alpine"
   661→
   662→          security_context {
   663→            allow_privilege_escalation = false
   664→            privileged                 = false
   665→            run_as_non_root            = true
   666→            capabilities {
   667→              drop = ["ALL"]
   668→            }
   669→            read_only_root_filesystem = true
   670→          }
   671→
   672→          env {
   673→            name  = "PGHOST"
   674→            value = "127.0.0.1"
   675→          }
   676→          env {
   677→            name  = "PGPORT"
   678→            value = "5432"
   679→          }
   680→          env {
   681→            name  = "PGDATABASE"
   682→            value = local.service.database.names.production
   683→          }
   684→          env {
   685→            name  = "PGUSER"
   686→            value = "postgres"
   687→          }
   688→
   689→          command = ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
   690→          args = [
   691→            <<-EOT
   692→            set -e
   693→            echo "Waiting for Cloud SQL Proxy to be ready..."
   694→            for i in $(seq 1 30); do
   695→              if pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U postgres > /dev/null 2>&1; then
   696→                echo "Cloud SQL Proxy is ready."
   697→                break
   698→              fi
   699→              if [ "$i" = "30" ]; then
   700→                echo "ERROR: Cloud SQL Proxy not ready after 60s"
   701→                exit 1
   702→              fi
   703→              echo "Attempt $i/30: proxy not ready, waiting..."
   704→              sleep 2
   705→            done
   706→
   707→            IAM_USER="${trimsuffix(google_service_account.crewai_platform.email, ".gserviceaccount.com")}"
   708→            echo "Granting privileges to IAM user: $IAM_USER"
   709→
   710→            for DB in ${local.service.database.names.production} ${local.service.database.names.cable} ${local.service.database.names.oauth}; do
   711→              echo "Granting privileges on database: $DB"
   712→              psql -d "$DB" -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SCHEMA public TO \"$IAM_USER\";"
   713→              psql -d "$DB" -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO \"$IAM_USER\";"
   714→              psql -d "$DB" -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO \"$IAM_USER\";"
   715→              psql -d "$DB" -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLES TO \"$IAM_USER\";"
   716→              psql -d "$DB" -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SEQUENCES TO \"$IAM_USER\";"
   717→            done
   718→
   719→            echo "Database initialization complete!"
   720→
   721→            # Gracefully stop cloud-sql-proxy sidecar
   722→            echo "Stopping Cloud SQL Proxy sidecar..."
   723→            wget -q -O- http://localhost:9091/quitquitquit || true
   724→            EOT

     2→# Generate environment-specific Helm values from config.json
     3→# Usage: ./scripts/generate-helm-values.sh <environment> [--check]

     5→# Generates TWO files per environment:
     6→#   1. environments/{env}/helm/values-upstream.yaml    - OCI chart overrides
     7→#   2. environments/{env}/helm/crewai-gateway/values-{env}.yaml - Gateway sidecar chart

    13→set -euo pipefail

   520→# AUTO-GENERATED from config.json - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

   526→  serviceName: "${service_name}"

   528→  serviceProtocol: "HTTP"
   529→
   530→# GKE Gateway
   531→gateway:

   533→  name: "crewai-${env}-gateway"
   534→  gatewayClassName: "${gateway_class}"
   535→  certificateMap: "${cert_map}"
   536→  listeners:

   538→      enabled: true
   539→      name: "http"
   540→      port: 80
   541→      allowedRoutes:
   542→        namespaces:

   544→    https:

   546→      name: "https"
   547→      port: 443
   548→      hostname: "${hostname}"

   552→
   553→# HTTPRoute

   558→  parentRefs:

   560→      sectionName: "https"

   569→
   570→# HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect

   662→# --- Generate both files ---

   665→

apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: crewai-credentials
  namespace: default
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: crewai-gateway-0.1.0
    app.kubernetes.io/name: crewai-gateway
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: crewai
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    environment: dev
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "-28"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    name: crewai-gcp-sm
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: crewai-platform-secrets
    creationPolicy: Owner
    template:
      type: Opaque
      metadata:
        labels:
          helm.sh/chart: crewai-gateway-0.1.0
          app.kubernetes.io/name: crewai-gateway
          app.kubernetes.io/instance: crewai
          app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
          app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
          environment: dev
  data:
    # Rails secrets
    - secretKey: SECRET_KEY_BASE
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev

      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev
        property: encryption_key

    - secretKey: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev
        property: active_record_encryption_primary_key

    - secretKey: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_DETERMINISTIC_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev
        property: active_record_encryption_deterministic_key

    - secretKey: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev
        property: active_record_encryption_key_derivation_salt

    - secretKey: CREWAI_PLUS_INTERNAL_API_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-rails-secrets-dev
        property: internal_api_key

    # GCS/S3 credentials (HMAC keys for S3-compatible access)
    - secretKey: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-gcs-credentials-dev
        property: access_key_id

    - secretKey: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-gcs-credentials-dev
        property: secret_access_key

      remoteRef:

      remoteRef:
        key: crewai-workos-credentials-dev
        property: api_key

    - secretKey: WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD

      remoteRef:

        property: github_token

        property: auth_token

> AGENT

PR #209 merged to develop. Here's a summary of what was restored:

**Problem**: During the refactoring, 4 of 5 GCP Secret Manager secrets were dropped from terraform and 13 of 16 ESO ExternalSecret mappings were lost. The GitHub Actions secrets (`TF_VAR_OAUTH_*`, `TF_VAR_GITHUB_*`, `TF_VAR_REPLICATED_AUTH_TOKEN`) had nowhere to flow to.

**What was restored**:

| Layer | Before | After |
|-------|--------|-------|
| **Terraform** (GCP SM secrets) | 1 (gcs_credentials only) | 5 (+ rails, workos, github, replicated) |
| **ESO ExternalSecret** (K8s key mappings) | 3 keys | 16 keys |

**Full pipeline now**:
```
GitHub Secrets → TF_VAR_* → Terraform → GCP Secret Manager → ESO → K8s Secret → Pods
```

**Important**: The GCP Secret Manager secrets for rails/workos/github/replicated don't exist yet — they'll be created when `terraform apply` runs on dev (via the CI workflow or manually). The ESO ExternalSecret will fail to sync until those GCP SM secrets are created by terraform.
